issues.details: JS calls action "edd_sl_sdk_update_tracking_" but no wp_ajax_edd_sl_sdk_update_tracking_ handler exists
AJAX handler "ms_dismiss_pro_notice" has no nonce verification (CSRF risk)
Template has data-action="<?php echo esc_attr( $button[" but no JS handler listens for it
Template has data-action="delete" but no JS handler listens for it

generated.verified_by: wp-plugin-onboard --refresh 2026-08-26; coverage gate run against grep ground truth, two categories hand-patched (see notes.generator_blind_spots)

endpoints.permission: public (report_permissions_check); SourceStatus::report() confirms with the platform's oEmbed, or believes only edit_post where there is no check

generator_blind_spots: tables: ms_watch_sessions_archive is created by str_replace() on the sessions schema (DB/Schema.php:84-88), not a literal CREATE TABLE, so write-manifest.mjs cannot see it. Patched in from ground truth; re-patch after every regeneration until the generator learns this pattern.
admin_pages: SetupWizard's add_submenu_page (includes/Admin/SetupWizard.php) was missed; only Menu.php's add_menu_page was found. Patched in from ground truth.

hooks_fired: multi-line apply_filters( \n 'hook', ... ) calls are missed by write-manifest.mjs — mediashield_adaptive_platforms (Support/Platforms.php) and mediashield_player_overrides (Player/FeatureOverrides.php) were patched in from ground truth for 1.3.0. Re-check multi-line firings after every regeneration.
notes.delta_1_4_2: Hand delta (Basecamp 10482094152): Upload\LibraryFiles adds the one-off job ms_protect_library_files (option ms_library_files_pending, Migrator v8), filters mediashield_library_files_batch_size and mediashield_library_file_in_use, video meta _ms_library_file and _ms_library_restore (also on attachments), WP-CLI subcommand 'mediashield repair restore-library-files', and an admin notice (option ms_library_files_report, dismissed by ?ms_library_notice=dismiss with nonce). wp/v2 video meta addresses (_ms_source_url, _ms_platform_video_id, _ms_stream_url) now need edit_post on the video; playlist items source_url likewise. MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 8.
notes.delta_1_4_2_posters: Hand delta (Basecamp 10499285942): CPT\Thumbnail adds the one-off job ms_rename_id_posters (option ms_poster_names_pending holds the last video ID checked, Migrator v10) and filter mediashield_poster_rename_batch_size; public helpers poster_filename(), sideload_poster() (the one platform-poster sideload, also called by Pro's YouTube/Vimeo/Wistia/Bunny imports), poster_url() (read path for every rendered poster) carries_id() and is_platform_poster(); attachment meta _ms_platform_poster marks MediaShield-made posters (set on sideload and rename), and only a marked poster is replaced or deleted. MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 10.
notes.delta_1_4_3: Hand delta (Basecamp 10501905898, 10528792946, 10527057137): Player\Protection adds public in_protected_folder() (the one test for 'URL is inside uploads/mediashield/', shared with Renderer::withhold_addresses()) and private must_gate(); filter_player_urls() always signs the /stream/ URL for a self-hosted file MediaShield holds (gated source, protected-folder URL, or _ms_owned_file) whatever ms_hide_source says. assets/js/protection.js starts DevTools detection only with a protected player (level other than none) on the page or from mediashield:player-ready; showOverlay() is a no-op without one. Integrations\Learnomy::add_embed_to_payload() asks AccessControl::can_watch() for every caller, not only guests. No new hooks, routes, options or tables. Basecamp 10517640742: Upload\LibraryFiles::protect() moves a file only when attachment_url_to_postid() finds a Media Library item; a file with none stays, video meta _ms_library_file = not_in_library, listed in the existing owner notice (report reason not_in_library). Dead no-attachment branches removed (edit_others_posts check; attachment-0 SQL in used_elsewhere(); Learnomy media_id guard); mediashield_library_file_in_use now always gets an attachment id. New one-off job ms_repair_library_files (public LibraryFiles::repair_batch(), option ms_library_files_repair_pending holds the last video ID checked, Migrator v11 for installs at DB 8-10, batch filter mediashield_library_files_batch_size) restores via restore() each video whose _ms_library_restore record has attachment 0 and a file path outside uploads YYYY/MM. MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 11. No new tables or routes. Basecamp 10530930729: new setting ms_lms_require_watch_pct (int 0-100, default 0 = off; settings 36 -> 37). New public SessionManager::watch_requirement( video_id, user_id ): ?{required, watched, met} (null when the setting is off or no video; the one rule for SessionController start/heartbeat, Learnomy::require_watch() and Pro LearnDashAdapter::watch_still_required(); watched = WatchedSpans::percent()). Integrations\Learnomy::require_watch() listens to Learnomy's learnomy_lesson_completion_rules: on a content_type mediashield lesson it appends a 'video' requirement 'Watch X% to complete', sets all_met false (strict) and reports completion_mode mediashield_watch for a Manual lesson, so Learnomy disables Complete and its /lessons/{id}/complete answers 422. Admin config gains isLearnomyActive; Settings screen gains a Lesson Completion card. No new routes, tables or fired hooks. Pro LearnDashAdapter listens to learndash_process_mark_complete and learndash_mark_complete_input_button_html. Basecamp 10530930695: new setting ms_watermark_show_ip (bool, default false; settings 37 -> 38). New public Player\Watermark::viewer_text( WP_User ) ('Name · email', 'Guest'). /session/start sends watermark_config.ip only when ms_watermark_show_ip is on. SessionController::get_client_ip() is now public (Pro's IP field reads it). watermark.js keeps the text off the paused .ms-bigplay. No new routes, tables or hooks. Basecamp 10530931001: ms_show_badge default true -> false (new installs only; seed_defaults() adds missing rows, stored values kept). .ms-badge is a pill in color-mix(--ms-accent 55%, #000) with white text. No new options, routes or hooks. Basecamp 10530930846: Sidebar.js groups routes into six top items (GROUPS: dashboard, videos, analytics, security, platforms, settings); a route not in the table joins route.group or Settings. Route hashes unchanged, mediashield_admin_routes unchanged; locked Pro items sit in their groups. No PHP change. Basecamp 10530930901: GET /analytics/overview adds protection {protected,total,alerts,blocked} and first_run {has_video,has_protected,has_view}; sessions_chart has one row per day of the period (fill_days()); recent_milestones is one row per viewer and video (MAX pct). New fired filter mediashield_dashboard_protection( summary, interval, now_utc ) (Pro fills alerts/blocked). Dashboard.js: Get started checklist replaces the old welcome hero (its CSS removed), Protection card, _n() views. Also fixes a stray '0' text node b2b4fa8 rendered in the sidebar. Basecamp 10530930776: Settings.js gains SettingsNav (SETTINGS_GROUPS: protection, watermark, player, access, ads, storage, integrations; each SectionCard has data-group) with a word-start search that hides non-matching .mediashield-settings__section cards (Pro's included) and a Go to section select on phones; the success snackbar reads 'Saved'. No PHP change. Basecamp 10530930631 (part 1): new settings ms_course_denied_text, ms_view_course_text, ms_unavailable_text (settings 38 -> 41). New public AccessControl::access_link( video_id, user_id ) and fired filter mediashield_video_access_link( null, video_id, user_id ) -> {title,url}; can_watch() adds 'link' to a refusal from mediashield_can_watch (not to login/role/domain refusals). /session/start 403 then says 'This video is part of <course>. Enroll to watch it.' with data.access_url / access_label. Integrations\Learnomy::course_link() answers from Learnomy's lessons table (published mediashield lesson -> published course, route_url). player.css hides the bar, centre play, fullscreen, speed and resume chip while an error or login overlay shows. Frontend message key 'unavailable'. Basecamp 10530930631 (part 2): player-wrapper.js adds addOverlayAction() (a View course link under the refusal when /session/start sends data.access_url) and showUnavailable() (opaque overlay, 'unavailable' message) for YouTube onError 100/101/150 and a Vimeo ready() rejection. Frontend message key 'viewCourse'. AccessControl::can_watch() return shape documents the optional link; Learnomy course_link() uses Learnomy's Lesson::for_mediashield_video() (U1). Basecamp 10531602227: new public SessionManager::last_played_position( video_id, user_id ) (newest session matching played_sql()); start() uses it for both the new-session and the dedup path. Owner decision (exact stop, like YouTube): WatchedSpans::record() takes the reported position and keeps it as 'p' in the same _ms_watched_spans entry (0 never overwrites); new public WatchedSpans::stop( user_id, video_id ): ?float; last_played_position() returns stop() first and falls back to the played-session max_position for guests and pre-1.4.3 viewings; heartbeat() records the stop for every logged-in report, with or without spans; PrivacyExporter adds 'Stopped at (seconds)'. Learnomy card 10533275569: admin App.js routes match exact hash first, then a route's sub-paths (#/route/x renders #/route; ErrorBoundary and Sidebar keyed on the route hash); Settings.js linkedGroup() reads #/settings/<group> (SETTINGS_GROUPS keys or a mediashield_settings_sections key) and SettingsNav scrolls to it on load and hashchange, holding 2 s while sections load; unknown group resets to #/settings at the top; nav clicks replaceState #/settings/<group>. Lesson Completion = #/settings/integrations. Basecamp 10530930729 (QA bounce): new Access\WatchedSpans (user meta _ms_watched_spans: merged watched intervals per video, each report capped by wall-clock time x2 + 3 s; exported, erased, removed on uninstall). SessionManager::watch_requirement() reads it; heartbeat() and end() take optional spans (REST arg 'spans' on /session/heartbeat and /session/end); total_seconds adds the accepted seconds (30 per playing beat for guests and span-less players). /session/start returns watch {watched_pct, required_pct} and /session/heartbeat watched_pct/required_pct when the requirement is on; tracker.js samples position once a second, reports spans, and sends one early beat when the member reaches the share. No new table or option. Basecamp 10530930776 (QA bounce): new JS wp.hooks filter mediashield_settings_sections ([] -> [{key,label,after,component}]) renders other plugins' sections inside the settings column with a nav entry after their group; nav is align-self:start and the content column clips instead of scrolling sideways on Settings so the nav sticks. Basecamp 10530930695/10530931001 (owner decision): new Admin\NewDefaultsNotice (admin_notices on screens whose id contains 'mediashield', manage_options; admin-post action mediashield_new_defaults with nonce; choices apply/keep/later). New runtime option ms_new_defaults_decided ('pending' set by Migrator v12 for sites updating from DB 1-11, then 'apply'/'keep'; deleted on uninstall); user meta _ms_new_defaults_snooze (one week). New fired filter mediashield_new_defaults (Pro adds watermark_fields). MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 12. admin.css notice suppression now exempts .ms-notice for direct children too.
notes.delta_1_4_4_front: Hand delta (Basecamp 10545260546): mediashield_playlist is no longer public (public, publicly_queryable, query_var, rewrite false; exclude_from_search true; show_ui and show_in_rest kept); PlaylistPostType::render_single() and its the_content filter removed; Migrator v13 drops rewrite_rules once so /playlist/<slug>/ answers 404 (MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 13). /playlists/{id}/items/reorder accepts POST, PUT and PATCH (the admin screens send POST); add, remove and reorder now need edit_post on that playlist (new PlaylistController::change_permissions_check()), listing items still needs edit_posts. Admin Playlists list drops its View link. Old addresses: PlaylistPostType::old_address_target() / redirect_old_address() (template_redirect 5) send /playlist/<slug>/ (on a 404) and ?mediashield_playlist=<slug> 301 to VideoUsage::page_for_playlist( id ) (new; first published, passwordless, viewable page with the Playlist block or shortcode, as a logged-out visitor; shares private first_readable() with page_for_viewer()), else 404. Edit screen: classic via use_block_editor_for_post_type (PlaylistPostType::classic_screen()), items box 'Videos in this playlist' in context ms_main drawn on edit_form_after_title (render_main_boxes()). No new hooks, options or tables.
notes.delta_1_4_4_status_and_protection: Hand delta (Basecamp 10545260436, 10545260510, 10545260458, 10545260667): Support\Platforms::recognise(url) -> {platform, video_id}|WP_Error mediashield_unplayable_source and unplayable_message(); VideoPostType refuses a new unplayable _ms_source_url on rest_pre_insert_mediashield_video (400) and on the edit screen (keeps the old link, notice via ?ms_source_refused=1); normalize_platform() stores the recognised YouTube/Vimeo/Wistia platform and id. Player\Protection::levels() (label, summary, adds), site_default_label(), LEGACY_SWITCHES, legacy_switches(), site_hides_source(): ms_hide_source / ms_detect_devtools / ms_pause_on_devtools apply site-wide only while a site keeps a non-default value; GET /settings adds ms_legacy_switches; PUT /settings with ms_default_protection deletes those three options. Admin\Menu::vocabulary() (defaultProtection, protectionLevels, siteDefaultLabel, unplayableMessage) is merged into mediashieldAdmin on the SPA and the wizard. New CPT\VideoStatus: video meta _ms_no_source = 1 (no source, stream or platform id, or only a link recognise() refuses), written on save, REST insert and any write of _ms_source_url / _ms_stream_url / _ms_platform_video_id; of(), counts() (one COUNT(*): all, ready, attention, draft, no_source, unavailable), query_args(), backfill() (Migrator v14, MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 14). New route GET /mediashield/v1/videos/counts; wp/v2/mediashield-videos gains arg ms_state (ready|attention|draft); ms_list.status adds no_source and draft, ms_list.source = uploaded file name. /analytics/overview protection gains attention; total and protected count Ready videos only; total_videos = Ready. New setting ms_watermark_show_email (default false, upgrade_default true); Settings::seed_defaults() honours a schema upgrade_default on a site with ms_db_version > 0; Watermark::viewer_text() adds the email only when it is on.  1.4.4 follow-up (owner decisions): Protection::SWITCHES_KEPT option ms_protection_switches_kept (set by Migrator v14 on a site updated from DB 1-13, removed when a level is picked, deleted on uninstall); legacy_switches() returns the old switches that are on for such a site or one that changed a switch. Protection::levels() None words follow ms_block_right_click. Upload\Drivers\SelfHosted::record_length( video_id, path ) (wp_read_video_metadata length -> _ms_duration) on every upload, and backfill_lengths() (Migrator v15, MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 15). No new tables or fired hooks. VideoUsage (Basecamp 10545260458 follow-up): prime() runs only for a list response that includes ms_list (VideoListController sets query var ms_prime_usage); the post_content scan is private scan( video_ids, playlist_ids, statuses ), whose WHERE asks, with one REGEXP per kind, for the saved forms of only the listed video ids and the playlists that hold them (id="N", id='N', id=N, "videoId":N, "playlistId":N), parsed again with ids_in()/playlist_ids_in(); no LIMIT 500 on the scan or the playlist read. page_for_playlist() uses the same scan. QA round 2 on Reign: Support\Platforms::plays_bunny() (new fired filter mediashield_plays_bunny, false in Free; Pro answers true with a connected Bunny library) is the one test for naming Bunny Stream; unplayable_message(), new link_hint() (edit screen field hint) and new wizard_link_hint() (admin config wizardLinkHint) use it. CPT\VideoStatus::library_choices() answers the public filter mediashield_library_choices( [], {page, per_page<=100, search} ) with [id => title] of published ready videos (CHOICES_MAX 100), for other plugins' choosers. VideoListController: ms_state now narrows within the requested statuses (status=publish&ms_state=ready = published ready only); VideoPickerModal asks ms_state=ready. Migrator v16 (MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 16) only re-runs seed_defaults() so ms_learnomy_new_lesson_pct is stored on sites that reached v15 before it existed. Admin words: Dashboard card and Realtime count say Watching now; Viewers row action is Stop playback. Ponytail review fixes: Migrator v15 only adds option ms_lengths_pending ('0'); new cron hook ms_backfill_lengths (SelfHosted::backfill_lengths(), 50 files a run by ID above the cursor, queued by SelfHosted::ensure_lengths_job() on init via Cleanup::schedule_single) saves the cursor before reading each file (a file that stops PHP is skipped next run) and deletes the option when done. VideoUsage usage index (no object cache): VideoUsage::register() hooks save_post (index(): parse the post's video and playlist shortcodes/blocks with ids_in()/playlist_ids_in() when its status is publish/future/draft/private), trashed_post and before_delete_post; write() stores post meta _ms_embeds {v,p} on the showing post and moves the difference onto one _ms_used_in row (post ID) per post on each video and playlist. Reads (prime()/for_video(), page_for_viewer(), page_for_playlist(), Videos list) use private places(): one postmeta join on _ms_used_in, or the content scan() while option ms_usage_index_pending exists. New cron hook ms_index_usage (build_index(): 100 posts naming mediashield a run by ID above the cursor, queued by ensure_index_job() on init); Migrator v18 (MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 18) adds the option for every install below 18. Uninstall deletes _ms_embeds. My Videos render.php applies mediashield_video_watch_url first and primes VideoUsage only for videos left without a page. VideoStatus::lacks_source(): a stored link with a stored _ms_platform plays (recognise() judges only a link without a platform); backfill() follows the same rule; new VideoStatus::clear_played_links() run by Migrator v17 (MEDIASHIELD_DB_VERSION 17) for sites at v14-v16. VideoPostType::length_label() and get_platform_label() removed (PlaylistRenderer::duration_label(), Platforms::label()).
notes.delta_1_4_4_player_states: Hand delta (Basecamp 10545260568, 10545260660): new CPT\SourceStatus (video meta _ms_source_unavailable {code, at}; mark_unavailable(), clear(), get(), check() = YouTube/Vimeo oEmbed status, report() rate-limited by transient ms_source_check_{id} for 600 s; hooks mediashield_video_status at 20 -> 'unavailable' and save_post_mediashield_video to clear). New route POST /mediashield/v1/videos/{id}/unavailable (REST\SourceReportController, public, arg code removed|private|not_embeddable|unknown). VideoListController ms_list.status may be 'unavailable'; Videos list label 'Unavailable at platform'. New settings ms_access_denied_url (url or empty) and ms_access_denied_button_text (default 'See membership options'), settings +2; /session/start 403 for a logged-in viewer adds data.access_url/access_label from them when no course link. Renderer prints data-edit-url for users with edit_post. player-wrapper.js: showErrorOverlay(el, message, onRetry, extra {sub, cause}) adds .ms-error-sub and, with data-edit-url, .ms-error-admin (cause + Edit video); showUnavailable(el, code, platform) adds Try again (rebuildPlayer() re-inits from the printed target) and a sendBeacon report; login overlay adds .ms-login-sub. Resume chip: 'Resume from m:ss' + 'Start over' (.ms-resume-chip__over), no auto-dismiss; while it shows, adapter.play() seeks to the saved position first and the big Play / iframe poster aria-label reads 'Resume from m:ss'; a play started elsewhere is caught by a 250 ms watch. Frontend message keys added: loginSub, unavailableSub, adminNote, editVideo, causeRemoved, causeNoEmbed, thePlatform, startOver; removed: dismiss. JS behaviour tests in tests/js (npm run test:js, local-ci stage 1.5). No new tables or fired hooks.
notes.delta_1_4_4_video_block: Hand delta (Basecamp 10545260523): new REST\VideoSummaryController: GET /mediashield/v1/videos/match?url= (edit_posts; Platforms::recognise() refusal answers 400; finds the oldest non-trashed video with the same _ms_platform + _ms_platform_video_id, or the same _ms_source_url for a video file; public static find()) and GET /videos/{id}/summary?post_id= (edit_posts + read_post; public static summary(): title, status, platform, platform_label, duration, thumbnail, protection, protection_label (Protection::levels()), follows_default, edit_url, used_in (VideoUsage, the edited post left out), used_in_more). New Support\Platforms::label( slug ) (YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia, Bunny Stream, Video file). Video block edit.js: paste asks /videos/match first and offers Use this video / Add as a new video; block preview shows poster + title + platform + length; sidebar shows title, platform and length, Protection with a Change on the video link, the other pages that show it, Pick a different video and Remove video; its protection select and duration field are removed (set on the video). No new hooks, options or tables.
notes.delta_1_4_4_qa_front: Hand delta (QA on 10545260523/10545260568/10545260546): new REST\LibraryPostsController (extends WP_REST_Posts_Controller; get_items/get_item permission checks need edit_posts, else rest_forbidden 401/403) set as rest_controller_class on mediashield_video and mediashield_playlist, so wp/v2/mediashield-videos and wp/v2/mediashield-playlists are editors only. VideoSummaryController::summary() title is entity-decoded plain text; protection_label is Protection::site_default_label() when the video follows the site. Player: a refused member with no access_url gets sub line messages.askOwner ('Ask the site owner for access.'); the editor note's Edit video link is a 40px target. tracker.js emitWatched() dispatches DOM CustomEvent mediashield:watched (bubbles) on the .ms-protected-player element with detail { videoId, watchedPct, requiredPct } on session start and after every heartbeat carrying watched_pct. No new routes, options, tables or PHP hooks.
notes.delta_1_4_4_picker: Hand delta (QA on 10545260523): VideoSummaryController::card( id ) (platform, platform_label, duration, thumbnail with the YouTube fallback, protection, protection_label via Protection::site_default_label()/levels(), follows_default) is shared by summary() and the new REST field ms_card on mediashield_video (null when the user cannot read the post). VideoPickerModal.js asks /wp/v2/mediashield-videos with _fields=id,title,ms_card, server search debounced 300 ms (orderby relevance), 20 per page with Show more from X-WP-TotalPages, reads through mediashieldRequest.readJSON(); rows are buttons with poster, title and "YouTube · 12:04 · Site default (Standard)", never a slug or id. Styles in src/admin/components/VideoPickerModal.css. No new routes, options, tables or hooks.
notes.delta_1_4_4_first_play: Hand delta (Basecamp 10545260660, coordinator walk): a viewing starts at the first play, not on page load (1.4.3 started one per player on ready). player-wrapper.js startOnFirstPlay() wraps adapter.play, listens for the native play event and polls adapter.isPlaying() every 250 ms for platform iframes; it holds the video (blockPlayback) until /session/start answers, then plays; the resume chip reads data-resume-position (new on .ms-player-target, Renderer, from new public SessionManager::resume_position( video, user ) = last_played_position() when Resume is on and the viewer is logged in). Chip and gate restore adapter.play only while they are the outermost wrapper. startSession() seeks to data.resume_position when the page carried no data-resume-position (cached markup). tracker.js: an early beat 5 s into play (firstBeatId), and while paused with no spans one beat in four. SessionManager::start() stream-limit count adds ( played_sql() OR started_at within 15 s ), so a viewing counts from its first play and an opened-but-never-played one stops counting after 15 s. QA round 2: new public AccessControl::refusal( access, user_id ): WP_Error (the one refusal, used by SessionController::start_session() and Renderer, which prints data-denied-code/-message and data-access-url/-label on a refused member's player; player-wrapper showRefusal() shows it with no request). tracker.js reportStop() beats at pause (native pause event; platform players via sample() within 1 s) and beaconStops() sends a heartbeat beacon when the tab hides; beaconUrl() puts _wpnonce after ? or & (plain permalinks). No new routes, options, tables or hooks.
notes.delta_1_4_4_low_level_watch: Hand delta (Basecamp 10541776164, 10537102216): a lesson watch rule is measured at None and Basic. player-wrapper measuresWatch() (logged in + data-watch-required > 0 or .ms-player-target data-watch-track=1) -> el._msTrackingOnly + startOnFirstPlay(); a failed start never holds the video (releaseTrackingOnly()); player-ready detail.trackingOnly. Renderer prints data-watch-track when SessionManager::watch_requirement() is non-null for the member. New public SessionManager::tracking_only( video_id ) (resolve_level none|basic) -> no stream limit at start; private limited_videos_sql() keeps such viewings out of other devices' count (postmeta _ms_protection_level, site default aware). SessionController /session/start answers watermark_config {enabled:false} for tracking-only. protection.js player-ready skips non-protected (None) players; ad-breaks.js skips trackingOnly. No new routes, options, tables or hooks.
notes.delta_1_4_4_create_video: Hand delta (Learnomy lesson editor door): new CPT\VideoCreator registers filter mediashield_create_video( null, { source_url?, attachment_id?, title? } ) -> int video id | WP_Error (mediashield_cannot_create_video 403 without create_posts on mediashield_video or edit_post on the attachment; mediashield_unplayable_source 400 from Platforms::recognise(); mediashield_not_a_video_file 404; insert error 500). Same insert as REST/edit screen (meta_input platform/id/url before save_post -> normalize_platform, Thumbnail title, VideoStatus, LibraryFiles move + private attachment), no protection level stamped; an attachment records SelfHosted::ORIGINAL_NAME and SelfHosted::record_length(). VideoCreator::find() (moved from VideoSummaryController, which now calls it) returns an existing video for the same platform id or file URL; find_by_attachment() reads _ms_library_restore. Listened-to filter, not fired by MediaShield. No new routes, options, tables or meta keys.
notes.delta_1_4_4_create_video_replacing: Hand delta (Learnomy Protect this video): mediashield_create_video args gain replacing { type: post|learnomy_lesson|<integration type>, id: int }. VideoCreator::create() runs inside new LibraryFiles::while_replacing( replacing, callable ) and, for an existing video, new LibraryFiles::recheck_in_use( video_id ) (only state in_use). used_elsewhere() leaves out post id for type post (posts and postmeta scans); fired filter mediashield_library_file_in_use gains 5th arg $replacing (array, [] when none). LibraryFiles::table_mentions_file() and table_has_value() gain optional int $skip_id (row id column `id`, clause added only when > 0). Integrations\Learnomy::library_file_in_use() takes 5 args and skips lesson id for type learnomy_lesson. No new routes, options, tables or meta keys.
notes.delta_1_4_4_ad_timeline: Basecamp 10235688440: ad-breaks.js AdController.syncTimeline() (1 s tick, the ad video's timeupdate, and at ad start/finish) moves .ms-ad-timeline__progress by the ad's own currentTime/duration (or the fixed display time of an image ad) while an ad plays (AdController.adNow), with .ms-ad-timeline.is-ad (amber bar, markers hidden) and caption 'Ad'; back to the lesson's position after. No PHP, hooks or settings change.
notes.delta_1_4_4_watch_rule: Hand delta: Integrations\Learnomy consumes learnomy_lesson_watched_pct (watched_pct(): WatchedSpans share for content_type mediashield lessons, else passes the value through) and learnomy_protected_video_default_watch_pct (default_watch_pct(): ms_lms_require_watch_pct); owns_watch_rule() = function_exists(\Learnomy\protected_video_measured), and when true require_watch() on learnomy_lesson_completion_rules returns the status unchanged. Admin\Menu localizes learnomyOwnsWatchRule. No new hooks fired, routes, options or tables.
notes.delta_1_4_4_free_review: Hand delta (Free 1.4.4 ponytail review, player/sessions/spans): new filter mediashield_measure_watch( false, video_id, post_id ) fired by private Renderer::measures_watch(); data-watch-track printed only when it returns true (Pro LearnDashAdapter::measure_on_lessons answers true on sfwd-lessons/sfwd-topic). WatchedSpans::MEASURED video meta _ms_measured_duration ([user_id => reported seconds] from at most 5 members; reports over 86400 s, or over 2x the median once 3 are kept, ignored; public WatchedSpans::measured( video ) = lower median; seeded from the member's legacy d; WatchedSpans::register() deletes it on added/updated/deleted_post_meta of VideoStatus::SOURCE_KEYS); percent() reads it when _ms_duration is 0. SessionManager::heartbeat(): guests and span-less players add LEAST(30, seconds since last_heartbeat) while playing instead of a flat 30; a heartbeat with progress calls new SourceStatus::clear_if_playing(). SourceStatus::check() asks Vimeo with the stored _ms_source_url and Referer home_url(); Vimeo 403, or 404 with a hashed link, is null; report() keeps the platform's answer (yes|no|unknown) in transient ms_source_check_{id} for 600 s whatever it was, so the platform is called at most once per interval; edit_post is read before the lock, so an editor records an 'unknown' at once; a recorded video clears on 'yes'. VideoCreator::create() saves pending without publish_posts. Final check: SourceStatus::fill_duration() (save_post_mediashield_video 25, rest_after_insert_mediashield_video 20) stores Vimeo's oEmbed duration in _ms_duration when it is 0 (shared private SourceStatus::ask() with check()); Shortcode answers mediashield_shortcode_source_url through a get_post_metadata filter for that render only and no longer writes _ms_source_url per view. player-wrapper.js: YouTube _playing changes only on PLAYING and PAUSED/ENDED; tracking-only players are never held (releaseTrackingOnly() removed); the first-play poll is el._msFirstPlayWatch at 1000 ms, cleared by begin() and rebuildPlayer(). No new routes, options or tables.
notes.honest_upload_143: 1.4.3 (Basecamp 10530929713): UploadManager::upload() takes a MySQL named lock per video (or per user+file) and refuses a concurrent upload with code upload_in_progress (REST 409); /upload/init answers 413 file_too_large when the body exceeded post_max_size. Uploader localizes maxUploadBytes/uploadTarget and checks size before sending.
notes.videos_list_143: 1.4.3 (Basecamp 10530930295): REST\VideoListController adds ms_list field + ms_platform/ms_protection args on wp/v2/mediashield-videos and POST /videos/bulk; CPT\VideoUsage batches 'used in' per list page.
